findings.note: Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and will play after missing three games with a high ankle sprain. That helps scoring, but he says the pain is only 'bearable,' so his mobility may still be limited, which works against the Over.

Baltimore went 1-2 without Jackson and failed to score in the second half of its last two games. Buffalo WR DJ Moore and TE Kincaid are questionable, and Ravens defenders Roquan Smith and Kyle Hamilton will play.

The final Week 8 report lists Ravens S Jaylinn Hawkins and G Ioane as out. For Buffalo, WR Shavers is out, and WR Moore, TE Kincaid, OT Spencer Brown and CB Alford are questionable, so pass-catcher depth on both sides is in doubt.
